a: The equator is 0° latitude and divides Earth into Northern and Southern hemispheres.
The prime meridian is 0° longitude, running through Greenwich.
There are seven continents in the common school model.
The Pacific is the largest ocean.
Antarctica is the largest desert; Sahara is the largest hot desert.
Nile and Amazon are both cited depending on measurement method.
Africa lies mainly between the Atlantic and Indian Oceans.
Time zones roughly follow longitude, adjusted by politics.
Weather is short-term; climate is long-term average patterns.
Map scale relates distance on the map to distance on the ground.
